title: C482/1549/2021 of MAYANK KAPOOR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Misc. Application No. 1549 of 2021
Mayank Kapoor ........... Applicant
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and another ........ Respondents

Present : Mr. Nalin Saun, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. for the State.
 Mr. Rajendra Arya, Advocate holding brief of Mr. Namanpreet Singh,
 Advocate for the private respondent.

JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 By means of the instant petition, the petitioner
seeks quashing of the chargesheet dated 03.04.2021,
summoning order dated 06.04.2021 passed in the case of
State v. Mayank Kapoor, under Sections 420, 120-B IPC
and 66-D of the Information Technology Act, 2000, by the
court of Judicial Magistrate, II, Dehradun ("the case"), as
well as the entire proceedings of the case pending before
the Judicial Magistrate, II, Dehradun, on the basis of
amicable settlement between the parties.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.

2
3. A joint compounding application has been filed
on behalf of the petitioner as well as the respondent no. 2
supported by the affidavits.
4. The petitioner is in jail. The victim is the
informant also. According to the first information report,
in the name of approving loan, she was duped with
Rs. 7,00,000/-.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the
parties that the parties have settled the dispute. The
money has already been given back to the informant,
therefore, the matter may be decided on the basis of
amicable settlement between the parties.
6. The respondent no. 2, informant, is present
through video conferencing, duly identified by her counsel.
She verifies the contents of the affidavit. She would
submit that she has settled the dispute. She has received
entire money; she does not want to proceed with the case.
7. Having considered, this Court is of the view that
it is a case which may be decided on the basis of amicable
settlement between the parties. Accordingly, the petition
deserves to be allowed.

3
8. The petition is allowed. The chargesheet dated
03.04.2021, summoning order dated 06.04.2021 as well
as the entire proceedings of the case are quashed.
9. Compounding application stands disposed of
accordingly.
10. The petitioner is in jail. Let he be set free, if not
wanted in any other case.
11. A copy of this order be forwarded to the court
below immediately through email also.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 12.04.2022
Avneet/
